best_hook.why: He pulls back her cloak to reveal a raw, bloody riding-crop welt across her shoulder: the one strong visual shock in a talky episode.

best_cliffhanger.why: After 'Who did this? ... Who?' she finally names 'Lady Catherine' and the clip cuts on his fury, so the viewer wants to see the revenge.

must_promos.why: He grabs her shoulder and she winces, the bloody welt is revealed, he demands who did it, she resists, then names Lady Catherine; a tight protective-husband beat that cuts on the villain's name.
'But it wasn't age.' leads to 'Poison.' 'Arsenic.' and his clenched fist, ending on the chilling slow-poisoning method with the poisoner unnamed.

standalone_risk: A stranger does not know who Lady Catherine or the Dowager Duchess are, why Juliana was disguised as a maid at Ashburg Manor, or why the Dowager matters so much to Alexander.
notes: Mostly two-person dialogue on a forest path; the wound reveal is the only physical moment. The poison reveal cannot be joined to the wound reveal inside 60 s.
